config_name: iPad Air 11-inch — M4 8-core CPU / 9-core GPU, 12GB RAM, 1TB SSD, 11" Liquid Retina + Magic Keyboard

specs.display_type: Liquid Retina IPS LCD (fully laminated, anti-reflective, no ProMotion)
specs.ports: 1x USB-C (USB 3 10Gb/s, DisplayPort), magnetic Magic Keyboard connector, Smart Connector
specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard for iPad Air 11" included in price: scissor keys with full function row (unlit), glass trackpad, cantilever hinge
specs.pen_support: Apple Pencil Pro +$168.99 (BBY sale; ~$199 Apple) — not included in total; Pencil USB-C +$99; hover supported

battery.notes: 28.93Wh cell. Apple claims 10h web/video Wi-Fi (9h cellular); users report ~8h mixed real-world use on the 11".

price.notes: Tablet-only $1,859.00 (apple.com/ca, verified 2026-11-24) + Magic Keyboard Air 11" $379.99 (BBY 19204080). Cellular variant +$200 ($2,059 tablet). Pencil Pro not included.

reviews.quote: The fiercest competitor for the iPad Pro is home-made. Pros: brute top performance, WiFi very fast, high-quality unibody chassis, USB-C with 10 GBit/s, two external displays possible, good color accuracy (PWM-free), well-balanced speakers, high recycled content. Cons: slow 60 Hz display, battery charging takes time, SoC throttles under sustained load. (NBC review of the iPad Air 13" M4 2026; 11" shares SoC and chassis design.)

praises: A terabyte in 464g — the ultimate no-compromise pocket workstation; users keep entire editing libraries on it offline (r/ipad)
M4 ProRes/AV1 media engine exports rival desktop chips despite the fanless design
10Gb/s USB-C keeps external RAID/fast SSD workflows viable
Same 12GB RAM and Wi-Fi 7 as every Air tier — capacity is the only thing that changed
Touch ID top button + Center Stage camera make hybrid work days seamless
complaints: $2,239 with keyboard crosses into M5 Pro 11" territory (tandem OLED, 120Hz, Thunderbolt) — the line's worst value point
60Hz 500-nit LCD at $2,200+ is indefensible to former ProMotion users
12GB RAM unchanged: big storage, same capability ceiling
Unlit keyboard, single port — accessory/dock costs pile on
iPadOS remains the real limit no terabyte fixes

design_philosophy: The niche extreme of the Air line: maximum capacity at minimum size, for users who want terabytes of offline pro-app storage in a 464g slate. Above 512GB the Air sells capacity rather than capability, and at 1TB it collides head-on with iPad Pro pricing.
rating_notes: Pro score attached from NBC review of the iPad Air 13" M4 2026 (87%, gap-fill 2026-11-24). Ratings inferred from the 13" M4 256GB line anchor (SHARED-ipad-air.md): 11" deltas per SHARED rules; creative_work +0.6 for 1TB headroom. standouts: 1TB + M4 in 464g: nothing else in the iPad family combines those two
10Gb/s USB-C keeps fast external storage workflows alive
dealbreakers: At $2,239 with keyboard the M5 iPad Pro 11" 256GB (OLED, 120Hz, Thunderbolt) is only ~$260 more — buy the Pro unless 1TB in 464g is a hard requirement
